__description: Built-in KBD orchestrator hooks. All entries in this file are tagged layer=builtin at load time. The 'report-progress' entry is the default reporter; a project can replace it by shipping a mode='override' entry covering '*:*' in .kbd-orchestrator/hooks-config.json.

hooks.description: Default reporter — emits the canonical KBD long-run progress signal for phases and tasks, and a compact fallback line for other hook kinds.

action.command:
if [ "$KBD_HOOK_EDGE" = "before" ]; then verb=Starting; else verb=Completed; fi; if [ "$KBD_HOOK_KIND" = "phase" ]; then printf '%s phase %s out of %s:  %s
' "$verb" "$KBD_HOOK_INDEX" "$KBD_HOOK_TOTAL" "$KBD_HOOK_NAME" >&2; elif [ "$KBD_HOOK_KIND" = "task" ]; then printf '%s task %s out of %s:   %s
' "$verb" "$KBD_HOOK_INDEX" "$KBD_HOOK_TOTAL" "$KBD_HOOK_NAME" >&2; else printf '%s %s %s out of %s: %s
' "$verb" "$KBD_HOOK_KIND" "$KBD_HOOK_INDEX" "$KBD_HOOK_TOTAL" "$KBD_HOOK_NAME" >&2; fi

hooks.description: Mirror every hook fire into surreal-memory (default-on when endpoint is reachable; no-op otherwise). Captures only structured KBD_HOOK_* values — no third-party stderr.

action.command: "${KBD_ORCHESTRATOR_ROOT:-$HOME/.claude/skills/kbd-process-orchestrator}/shared/lib/memory-log.sh"

hooks.description: Populate prior-context.md (lessons for the lead view, pk knowledge, previous reflection, knowledge gaps) from the shared recall library before each /kbd-assess. Composes with on_failure: ignore so a missing memory endpoint never blocks assess.

action.command: "${KBD_ORCHESTRATOR_ROOT:-$HOME/.claude/skills/kbd-process-orchestrator}/skills/kbd-memory-recall/kbd-memory-recall.sh" "$KBD_HOOK_NAME" assess

hooks.description: Write the assess stage handoff summary to memory at visibility lead (agent_id <team>/@lead) through learning_write. No-op when the pack's shared scripts or python3 are absent.

hooks.description: Persist a completed canonical task boundary to session history and project-scoped memory.

action.command: script="${KBD_ORCHESTRATOR_ROOT:-$HOME/.claude/skills/kbd-process-orchestrator}/../karpathy-progress-memory/scripts/record-progress.py"; python3 "$script" --project-root "$PWD" --from-hook --boundary task

hooks.description: Persist a completed canonical change boundary to session history and project-scoped memory.

action.command: script="${KBD_ORCHESTRATOR_ROOT:-$HOME/.claude/skills/kbd-process-orchestrator}/../karpathy-progress-memory/scripts/record-progress.py"; python3 "$script" --project-root "$PWD" --from-hook --boundary change

hooks.description: Persist a completed canonical phase boundary to session history and project-scoped memory.

action.command: script="${KBD_ORCHESTRATOR_ROOT:-$HOME/.claude/skills/kbd-process-orchestrator}/../karpathy-progress-memory/scripts/record-progress.py"; python3 "$script" --project-root "$PWD" --from-hook --boundary phase
echo '[kbd-orchestrator] Phase complete — run /kbd-reflect to generate reflection report, then /kbd-new-phase to start next phase'
echo '[kbd-orchestrator] Change complete — record it with prometheus kbd change transition --status complete, then run /opsx:verify + /opsx:archive (if OpenSpec)'
echo '[kbd-orchestrator] Assessment written — run /kbd-plan to generate change list'
echo '[kbd-orchestrator] Plan written — run /kbd-execute to select backend and dispatch'
echo '[kbd-orchestrator] Cross-tool handoff — receiving tool should read current-waypoint.json and progress.json before starting'
echo '[kbd-orchestrator] Blocker detected — record it with prometheus kbd blocker record; compatibility projections refresh from the runtime'
echo '[kbd-orchestrator] Reflection complete — waypoint advanced to next phase, run /kbd-new-phase <name> to begin'

hooks.description: Open a surreal-memory task stream for the phase at execute start (best-effort; outbox-buffered when the endpoint is down).

action.command: for r in "${KBD_PACK_ROOT:-}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}" "${KBD_ORCHESTRATOR_ROOT:-$HOME/.claude/skills/kbd-process-orchestrator}/../.." "${KBD_ORCHESTRATOR_ROOT:-$HOME/.claude/skills/kbd-process-orchestrator}/../../.."; do src="$r/shared/scripts/lib/memory-bridge.sh"; if [ -n "$r" ] && [ -f "$src" ]; then . "$src" && mem_create_task_stream "kbd:${KBD_PROJECT_NAME:-prometheus-skill-pack}:${KBD_HOOK_NAME}" || true; exit 0; fi; done; exit 0

hooks.description: Persist the accepted phase reflection (Delta / Root Cause / Corrective Actions, Lessons Learned, Next Phase Seed) as attributed lessons through learning_write: [GLOBAL]/[USER] lines to global/user scope, the rest to project. Skips rejected reflections. Resolves memory-writeback.sh through the plugin root, then the flat installed layout, then the source tree.
